description.text:
The HS Trainer Kit, released on 12 May 2010 in English and European languages only, held two 30-card half decks, Gyarados and Raichu, with a HeartGold & SoulSilver booster pack, damage and status counters, a Pikachu coin, a playmat and a deck box. New to this kit were the Trainer Kit Guides, one per half deck, which walk players through an example battle up to the eighth turn, and individual numbers for every card in a half deck where earlier kits gave copies of a card one number. The cards are reprints from HeartGold & SoulSilver with the kit's own set symbol and no rarity mark; the featured Pokémon, holo and non-holo, have artwork different from their HeartGold & SoulSilver cards, and the Energy lacks the Pokémon and place pictures of the HeartGold & SoulSilver Energy.

The Gyarados half deck runs on Water Energy, numbered 1/30 to 30/30.
